tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the 50+ cities CityWalk Plan can build a walking itinerary for, grouped by region. Call this first if unsure whether a city is supported.

tools.name: plan_city_walk
tools.description: Generate a day-by-day walking itinerary for a city from CityWalk Plan's hand-curated catalog. Stops are real places with verified coordinates (not AI-invented), grouped by neighborhood so each day stays in one area with minimal backtracking. Returns the itinerary plus a citywalkplan.com link to edit/share/export it.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. 'Paris', 'tokyo', 'New York'.

days.description: Number of days (1-5, same as the web planner). Default 3.

pace.description: easy ~3 stops/day, balanced ~4, packed ~5. Default balanced.

must_see.description: Optional place names to prioritize, e.g. ['Eiffel Tower'].

lang.description: Language for the returned plan_url so the trip opens localized — set it to the user's language (e.g. 'ja', 'zh-Hans', 'fr'). Default 'en'.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Look up one place in a city's CityWalk Plan catalog (type, neighborhood, suggested duration, description, coordinates, Wikipedia link).

place.description: Place name or part of it, e.g. 'Louvre'.
